statement: For A ⊂ L set fA(X) = N X i=1 e−dK (xi,A) , f∅ = 0, where the distance is to the set of site centers. Every normalized nonnegative bosonic ground function obeys log Z ezfA dµ ≤ CzD|A| (0 ≤ z ≤ 1). (2.13) The constants are uniform for K ≥ 100, D sufficiently large, and α ∈ Iα.
